rawRetro.summary: Repaired the four failed service-desk criteria. B03: the return action now sends a submitted ticket back to the engineer (status processing, action returned) instead of the dead-end rejected state, only the supervisor can close/return, and a closed ticket is read-only for both attachments and lifecycle actions. B04: a temporarily shared ticket and an observer view are read-only, observer reads hide internal notes, and a confidential ticket is limited to the supervisor and its assignee (shares never open it). B06: attachment bytes are gated by ticket visibility (integrator denied), a corrupt image now shows explicit failure feedback with a download fallback, and removing an attachment removes the correct link. B07: the durable in-app message center is a real production page with navigation. Verified against the production build in a real browser plus the server self-tests.

blockers.title: Return dead-ends the ticket and engineers can close; closed tickets still accept attachments
blockers.symptom: Returning a submitted ticket moved it to rejected with no way back (b03-returned-to-engineer.png); an engineer saw the supervisor-only Confirm/close/Return actions (b03-engineerA-can-close.png); a closed ticket still offered attachment upload (b03-closed-upload-allowed.png, b03-closed-ticket2-upload-allowed.png).
blockers.rootCause: TicketService.reject() set status='rejected' instead of returning the ticket to processing; engineer capability closeTickets was true, so the UI exposed the confirmation actions to the assignee; linkFile/unlinkFile did not check the ticket status, and the page gated the uploader only on canOperate/status in a way that left the closed case editable.
blockers.fix: reject() now requires pending_confirmation, sets status='processing', keeps the reason in rejectionReason and logs action 'returned' (with a durable notification to the assignee). ENGINEER_CAPABILITIES.closeTickets=false, and TicketService capabilities.canClose = closeTickets && canOperate. linkFile/unlinkFile reject TICKET_OPEN_STATUSES violations with 409, and ticket-detail.tsx only renders the uploader/remove controls when canOperate and the status is open.
blockers.verification: Self-test: submit -> reject -> processing with reason and returned log, resubmit -> close, then closed reads/actions 409. Production browser: engineer_b close on a pending_confirmation ticket -> 403; closed ticket 4 shows 0 file inputs and 0 remove buttons for engineer_a and supervisor; engineer capabilities.canClose=false.

blockers.title: Shared and observer views were writable, internal notes leaked, confidential tickets unsupported
blockers.symptom: Engineer B saw Add files on a ticket shared to them (b04-engineerB-shared-ticket5.png); the observer list likewise exposed write affordances (b04-observer-tickets-list.png); internal resolution/rejection notes were visible to observers; there was no way to mark a ticket confidential.
blockers.rootCause: The detail page gated the attachment editor on view/operate too loosely, TicketService.get() returned internal note fields and log detail to any viewer, and the repair ticket model had no confidentiality concept, so canView/canShare/canOperate could not restrict it.
blockers.fix: Added migration 202610080003 adding a confidential boolean (default false) to repair tickets, to the DTO/input and to the create path. canView for a confidential ticket allows only the supervisor and its assignee (temporary shares never open it); canOperate likewise; createShare rejects confidential tickets; get() nulls resolution/rejectionReason/acceptanceNote/acceptanceError and log detail for observers and sets canShare=false for confidential. ticket-detail.tsx gates the uploader/remove on canOperate && open status and shows a confidential badge; tickets.tsx can create a confidential ticket.
blockers.verification: Self-test: confidential ticket readable by the assignee, 403 for another engineer and for the observer, share creation 403. Production browser: engineer_b on a shared ticket 5 and the observer on ticket 5 both show 0 file inputs/0 remove buttons; observer GET ticket 3 returns resolution=null, rejectionReason=null, log detail [null] and canShare=false while the supervisor sees them.

blockers.title: Attachment bytes not access-controlled, corrupt image had no failure feedback, remove did not work
blockers.symptom: The integrator could download a ticket attachment (b06-integrator-attachment-access.png); a corrupt PNG rendered as a broken image without an explicit failure message (b06-corrupt-preview.png); Remove on an attachment did nothing (b06-remove-attempt.png).
blockers.rootCause: The File plugin's generated content route was public, so any caller (or none) could fetch bytes; the image previewer had no onError fallback; FileList used FileRecord.key for the delete link id, but ticket-detail.tsx set key to the file UUID instead of the ticketFiles link id.
blockers.fix: server/routes/file-api.ts now wraps the generated contributions: the upload paths require a session, and the content route additionally runs requireIdentity plus TicketService.canAccessFile, which parses the leading UUID and allows the read only if the file is unlinked or linked to a ticket the caller can view (403 otherwise, 401 anonymous). file-preview-content.tsx renders an image with onError -> DownloadFallback and a localized 'This image could not be displayed.' message. toFileRecords now puts the link id in FileRecord.key so onRemove deletes the right link.
blockers.verification: Self-test: anonymous 401, integrator 403, assigned engineer not 403, plus the corrupt-image fallback component test. Production browser: /uploads/tickets/<uuid>.docx returns 401 anonymous, 403 integrator, 200 observer/engineer_a; DOCX preview renders on a canvas; corrupt upload and remove exercised against the built app.

blockers.title: No message center for accept/return/submit-confirm notifications
blockers.symptom: b07-no-message-center.png: the in-app notification plugin only registered a development page, so production users had nowhere to read the durable notifications the accept, return and submit-confirmation flows produce.
blockers.rootCause: The notification-in-app plugin contributes its inbox only under a development-only route; the application had no production page, route or navigation entry for it.
blockers.fix: Added client/pages/service/messages.tsx (PageContainer + NotificationInAppProvider + NotificationInAppInbox), declared the /messages route in client/routes.ts with navigation.messages and a Bell icon (auth required, authz skip because the API scopes items to the session), added navigation.messages to both locales, and updated the route-navigation and client-routes tests.
blockers.verification: Production browser: /messages renders with the 'Message center' title, description, Mark all read and the Messages list. Self-tests: route-navigation, plugin-page-authz, locale coverage and client-routes pass.

improvements.title: Migrations and seeds were edited after being applied, so the runtime reports checksum drift
improvements.detail: Starting the app against the existing storage/database.sqlite warns that 202610070003_create_repair_tickets, 202610070004_create_ticket_collaboration, 202610070006_create_knowledge_inspections and both 2026100800xx seeds no longer match the recorded checksum. The sources are still unmerged, so the supported correction is `pnpm nocobase db redo` (or db repair when the edit left the schema identical); the fresh-install path is unaffected. Freeze migration and seed sources once a run that applied them has happened.

improvements.title: DOCX preview could not be reproduced as broken
improvements.detail: The B06 evidence showed the DOCX preview stuck on Loading, but the same sample.docx renders to a canvas in roughly 3.7s in both the dev server and the production build (the only image-path change was the corrupt-image fallback). The two QA screenshots b06-docx-preview.png and b06-docx-preview-loaded.png are byte-identical, which points at a capture/readiness artifact rather than a render failure; a criterion that waits for rendered output should allow for the wasm-backed first paint instead of screenshotting before it completes.

improvements.detail: The B06 evidence showed the DOCX preview stuck on Loading, but the same sample.docx renders to a canvas in roughly 3.7s in both the dev server and the production build (the only image-path change was the corrupt-image fallback). The two QA screenshots b06-docx-preview.png and b06-docx-preview-loaded.png are byte-identical, which points at a capture/readiness artifact rather than a render failure; a criterion that waits for rendered output should allow for the wasm-backed first paint instead of screenshotting before it completes.

checks.criterion: 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。
普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。
负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。
甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。
有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。
上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。
受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。
用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。
主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。
通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。
主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。
